name: Product and variant setup planner
why: Sorts products and variants into a clean table before mapping them to each marketplace's fields.

name: Make matching photos for a product sheet and check them
why: One matching photo per product with a marketplace rules check, for bulk listings.

name: Turn a clothing flat lay into marketplace-ready photos
why: Marketplace-ready apparel photos for sellers moving onto fashion marketplaces.

name: Product photo set maker
why: A planned and checked photo set for one real product, for listings that need more images.

name: Product margin checker
why: True margin per product from every cost, to sit alongside the what-you-keep sheet.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: Cost per sellable unit from quotes and freight, for new-country entry plans.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: The deepest discount a margin allows, before a marketplace promotion or price change.

name: Price test keeper
why: Plans one reversible price test on a channel and reads the result.

name: Customer inbox triage and reply drafter
why: Ranks buyer messages and drafts checked replies for approval.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Checked replies to public reviews, with risky ones held, for marketplace feedback and delivery app ratings.

name: Monthly returns and refunds reviewer
why: Finds the products driving refunds, which feed claims and account health.

name: Etsy shop opening planner
why: A plan for opening an Etsy shop: listings, photos, price check and launch steps.
